scope: Private audio diagnosis and five requested Iraqi/MSA samples; no production deployment or film replacement.

findings.meaning: Shows final film retained original narration signal; not a speech-intelligibility or pronunciation score.
findings.confirmedBoundaryBug: Original unpunctuated MSA reference ended in an Arabic letter. Habibi infer_batch_process concatenates reference and target and only supplies its own space for ASCII-ended references. Our caller omitted the corresponding target separator used by the upstream benchmark.
findings.fix: Add a single leading target separator for Arabic-ended references; preserve reference transcript and original story metadata.
possibleContributors: Original narration used 27 combining marks and speakingRate 0.9. Duration estimation uses raw UTF8 byte counts. Some supplied punctuation/marks are absent from the exact MSA vocabulary.
Reference was a licensed short benchmark excerpt with listeningVerified=false, not an auditioned and approved production narrator.
Original narration split into five chunks, so prosody can reset between them. These five short samples use a single chunk each.
findings.notClaimed: No ASR WER score or confirmed human listening approval; improvements need listening to these samples.

samples.label: عراقي — طبيعي
samples.text: هلا بيك. شلونك اليوم. خل نحكي حكاية حلوة من واقعنا.

samples.label: عراقي — هادئ

samples.label: فصحى — طبيعي
samples.text: نعيش وكأن الوقت لا ينتهي. لا نؤجل الاعتذار لمن نحب.

notes: Two existing reference speakers across five recordings; no claim of five separate speaker identities. Preview MP3 uses gain only, without pitch shift, time stretch, denoising or background audio.
